hint11: Sorted by board rank. Click MC/Rev net for cheapest-net-cash-flow-first (the primary dial; net-dilutive and blanks sort last), or any header to re-sort. Fees ann. and Holders rev ann. are ANNUALIZED (30-day run-rate × 12.17). MC for ENA/LIT/JUP/PUMP uses CoinPaprika-implied supply (June-dated stamps — estimates). Trade vol 30d = monthly TRADE VOLUME on the exchange tokens' own markets (blank for non-exchanges): LIT from Lighter's own API (daily ×30); HYPE baked = spot orderbook only (June perp volume ≈ $267B, T3) though live mode adds the perp leg from Hyperliquid's own API; JUP = aggregator leg only. MC/Rev net = MC ÷ (holders rev − next-12-mo supply-in: unlocks + emissions at realized pace, the NETFLOW in-legs) — the multiple AFTER dilution; "net-dilutive" = supply-in currently exceeds holders revenue (sorted after all real multiples); blank where the in-leg is unknown (e.g. LIT's undisclosed vesting). NEW (owner 7/22 late): MC/FDV = dilution headroom (low = deep overhang — HYPE 0.26 · LIT 0.25; ~1.0 = fully diluted — ETH 1.00 · AAVE 0.95); FDV/Rev = the fully-diluted multiple, the overhang-adjusted lens (JUP: ~26.6× on MC → ~56× on FDV).
